scope: Bounded Psalms catalogue reconciliation: 39 existing biblical-dataset labels plus 14 literary-context targets; not an independent-manuscript census or complete allusion catalogue.

policy.nonbiblical_dataset_check: exact-label metadata only; no verse-reference scan or reading verification
policy.source_record_ordinals: zero-based within named QDR dataset; never interchangeable across files
policy.modern_index_ordinals: one-based within pinned full Qumran-Digital index
policy.genre: editorial source classification and discovery role, not an automatic textual vote
